evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: The imperative is categorical and directs complete cessation, making it settled rather than exploratory.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge about the Kestrelwood spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work.

observations.why: The directive uses the absolute commitment marker “all knowledge” and specifies an expected action, so it is decision-grade rather than merely a claim.
The unhedged assertion uses the categorical temporal intensifier “never”; although it is a claim in form, its absolute wording makes the position settled as performed here.
